bank_name: the jalna peoples co operative bank ltd jalna

website_metadata.notes: Official site jpcb.bank.in (Jalna; tel 02482-237761) is live with a Term Deposit menu (FDR /pages/fdr/, CDR /pages/cdr/, RD, Pigmy) but every product page only describes the scheme — no FD interest-rate table, image rate-card, or PDF is published. Probed /deposit-rates, /interest-rate, /pages/cdr/ — all generic pages with zero rate numbers.

warnings: Do NOT confuse with jpc.bank.in (Jalgaon Peoples Co-op Bank, tel 0257) which has a /deposit-rates page — different bank.
FDR page text: 'Fixed Deposit Ordinary Scheme at Very Competitive Interest Rates. Interest payable on monthly basis' — no figures.
